sentences.en: Once capsized, a catamaran is impossible to right without help.
sentences.zh: 一旦翻船，双体船没有帮助是无法扶正的。

sentences.en: Our boat suddenly capsized, and everyone fell into the river.
sentences.zh: 我们的船突然翻了，大家都掉进了河里。
